title: MUSCLE MANGA - Baki Hanma's Physique in Grappler Baki (part. 2)
summary: NH continues analysing Baki Hanma's physique and character arc in Grappler Baki, from the post-Yasha Ape bulk through the fights with Hanayama and Gaia to the showdown with Yujiro. He discusses which parts of Baki's physique are natty-achievable, his training and feats, and his evolution toward befriending opponents.
claims: Baki gained about 20 lb, going from an athletic 156 lb to almost 180 lb at about 5'2" while staying fairly lean, on a full-body routine and over 10,000 kcal a day
Most of Baki's new mass is in the upper back and posterior chain, the muscles that matter most for transferring ground force into strikes
Baki befriending his opponents was radical in 1991, years before Luffy or Naruto
From the front Baki's physique, with short clavicles and a large waist, is still natty-achievable; his back size and definition border on natural impossibility
Upper back is underdeveloped in most lifters, so the limits of natural upper back thickness may be higher than people assume
Reaching that much size at such low body fat would require fully specialising in bodybuilding; being that massive and still nimble and fast is impossible in real life
In the manga Baki is estimated at around 80 kg, keeping the mass he built for the Yasha Ape fight
Baki's arc shows a well-developed physique beats weaker opponents and contradicts the idea that grapplers can only get big at the cost of fighting ability
Training while weighted, like Baki's diving weights and 2 kg shoe soles, is a cool fighting-manga trope but doesn't mean it works in real life
